name: Mike Nield
story: In a 2011 conference presentation, Taranaki Regional Council manager Mike Nield described the riparian-planning GIS application as a joint development with Explorer Graphics, using Esri technology and delivered as an ArcGIS/ArcView ArcMap extension called the Land Management Application. Land-management officers worked through an LMA toolbar and menu while plan status could also be reported through the corporate intranet GIS.
